proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: injectivity follows by combining the pre-equivalence view of the groupoid with the restrict lemma; surjectivity uses the sheaf-theoretic characterization: a section of U/R locally comes from f in U(T), and if h: U' x_{g,U,t} R -> U is a surjection of sheaves one refines further so that f factors through h, whose projections give sections f'_i of U' with g f'_i equivalent to f via pr_1 f_i, so sigma locally lies in the image of U'/R'; the sufficient conditions follow since a tau-covering induces a sheaf surjection and U' -> U surjective makes h surjective using the neutral section e of s (source lines 4103-4132)
